semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company is involved in the trading and refurbishment of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, which is a critical support function in the semiconductor value chain.
summary: STEL Equvo Corporation specializes in the trading and refurbishment of used semiconductor manufacturing equipment. They offer services such as trade-in, purchase, and sale of equipment, along with parts sales and repair services. The company also supports leasing companies in expanding their sales channels.
